dossier.title: Survey Pilot Down
briefing: A survey pilot is adrift in an escape pod one jump out from {HERE}. I'm {PATRON}, and she's my pilot. You're going to scoop that pod and bring her in alive.
Get her to dock breathing, and we're square—you get paid. Any station will do, as long as she's safe.
But if she doesn't make it to dock alive? If she's sold off or dies out there? Then we're done, and I don't pay.

pod.arrive: Scoop the escape pod at {TARGET} and dock your passenger for {PAY}.

data.arrive: Return to {TARGET} with the survey data for {PAY}.

dossier.lead: Distress call from {PATRON} at {WORLD}: a survey pilot adrift needs rescue.

rumour.far: {PATRON} at {WORLD} offers credits for rescuing a survey pilot from an escape pod.
rumour.near: {PATRON} at {WORLD} is calling urgent—survey pilot adrift one jump out, rescue needed.

dossier.news: {PATRON} at {WORLD} pays for rescue work—a survey pilot is down in a pod.

story.opening: Day {DAY} at {WORLD}: the commander accepted a rescue mission for a downed survey pilot.
